title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.12598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Exper

translated_title: 超越二元可验证奖励：面向软件工程智能体的行为自我奖励
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过可执行测试为软件工程智能体提供可靠的监督信号，但二元奖励无法区分调试质量差异巨大的轨迹。我们研究了当前策略能否评判自身的轨迹，并利用这些评判来提升任务性能，而无需单独训练的奖励模型。为此，我们提出了行为自我奖励（BSR），这是一种奖励精炼方法，它复用策略模型来比较同一任务中具有相同验证器结果的多条轨迹之间的可观察调试行为。BSR将成对偏好聚合为任务局部分数，并将其转换为有界的辅助奖励，在保持验证器定义的通过/失败排序的同时引入奖励对比。这无需新的环境交互，即可从已收集的轨迹中获得额外的监督信号。
tldr: 提出行为自我奖励（BSR）方法，让策略模型自我评判同一任务中相同验证结果轨迹间的调试行为差异，将其转化为有界辅助奖励，从而在二元可验证奖励之上引入更精细的监督信号，且无需单独的奖励模型或新的环境交互。
en_tdlr: Proposes Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), which reuses the policy to compare debugging behaviors among trajectories with identical verifier outcomes and converts pairwise preferences into bounded auxiliary rewards, providing finer-grained supervision beyond binary verifiable rewards without a separate reward model or new environment interactions.
